cards.title: Water Mage: final art
cards.text: Her art is still the placeholder sketch. Three takes, sea blues; staff or orb in her right hand.
cards.why: She went in on a quick sketch built on the Frost Mage's file. Each take keeps her parts, so the beam, cannon and bubbles still come from her right side. Each picture is the take beside the art in the game now, at 3x and at game size.

items.label: Wave
items.text: Her hood rises at the back into a breaking wave; a foam ruff; driftwood staff.

items.label: Orb
items.text: No hood: sea-green hair, a starfish pin, shell circlet; a ball of water held up.

items.label: Shell
items.text: A sea priestess in a conch shell hood, fin frills, a coral staff.

cards.title: Quartermaster: new look
cards.text: Your note: 'Overall don't like... Needs to be more unique.' His kit changed; his art never did.
cards.why: Round 13 gave him crates, a barricade and a pot to throw, but he still wore the old merchant. Each take is built round his new kit, with both fists on the straps as now.

items.label: Pot helmet
items.text: A cooking pot for a helmet (his Pot Helmet), moustache, pans and a boot on his pack.

items.label: Ledger
items.text: A supply clerk: peaked cap, crates on a carrying frame, a ledger in one fist.

items.label: Big sack
items.text: A small packer under a huge patched sack with a broom, pan and boot poking out.

cards.title: Beekeeper: new look
cards.text: Your note: 'Overall don't like. Visuals...' The kit was redone, the art wasn't. Three takes.
cards.why: Same parts as now: the smoker in his right fist (now held out where it shows, puffing), a free left fist, bees around him that the game can move.

items.label: Veil hood
items.text: The beekeeper's suit: a white hood with a black mesh window, honey gloves.

items.label: Skep hat
items.text: A straw beehive worn as a hat, bees crawling on it, a striped scarf, a beard.

items.label: Bee beard
items.text: A beard that is a swarm of bees, under a wide straw sun hat.

cards.title: Bandit: new look
cards.text: Your note: 'Overall don't like hero.' He still wears the enemy bandits' red bandanna. Three takes.
cards.why: His kit was redone (Hostage, Bolas, Light Fingers), but the art is the round-5 one the Wildwood's bandits also wear. The cutlass stays in his right fist, so Disarmed still takes it.

items.label: Highwayman
items.text: A tricorn with a red feather, a black mask, a wine coat with the collar up.

items.label: Cutpurse
items.text: A green hood with a long tail, a scarf over the mouth, purses on a cord.

items.label: Rascal
items.text: A floppy hat pushed back, stubble, a gold earring, bolas over one shoulder.

cards.title: Winter Queen: boss art
cards.text: You said keep her but bring her up to a boss. Three takes; her face has blue lips and a frost mark now.
cards.why: Her art is from art round 9: a blank pale face and a small crown. Same parts as now: the train sways, both hands lift when she casts. Her mirrors stay drawn in code.

items.label: Spire crown
items.text: Five tall ice spires, an ice-shard collar, a frost mantle, a snowflake in her hand.

items.label: Fur mantle
items.text: A circlet of hanging icicles over a lilac veil, a white fur mantle, an ice sceptre.

items.label: Glacier
items.text: Armour of glacier ice, a crown of shards, a white braid, an ice dagger in each fist.

cards.title: Goblin Chieftain: art
cards.text: Your note on 0.12: the art isn't good. Three takes, drawn as one of the goblins, only a chief.
cards.why: Your notes kept: one clipped ear, fixed teeth (lower fangs), more war paint, a weapon in each fist held forward with the edges in. The goblins' own build: big ears, long nose.

items.label: Boar skull
items.text: A boar's skull helmet, black feathers, spears on his back, two cleavers.

items.label: Mohawk
items.text: The red mohawk kept, a hand print of paint, a tooth necklace, a wolf pelt, two axes.

items.label: Stolen crown
items.text: A king's crown far too small, a stolen royal cape, a cleaver and a sceptre-club.

cards.title: Grave Warden: own art
cards.text: The Crypt's mini-boss still wears the Brute skeleton's sprite. Three of its own.
cards.why: It has been a powered-up stand-in since the Crypt was built. Each take is a big skull in the Bone King's family, dressed for the graveyard, with a weapon to swing.

items.label: Gravedigger
items.text: A ragged green cowl, a grave spade, a lantern with a green ghost-light.

items.label: Coffin lid
items.text: A rusted pot helm with a bone crest, a coffin lid for a shield, a flanged mace.

items.label: Undertaker
items.text: A tall black hat, a grey shroud, a coffin-maker's mallet, a ring of keys.
